biggest_catch: Upfluence is brand-facing influencer software — its official pages show brand templates where the dollar amount, percentage, and payment days are left blank for each brand, so there is no concrete public creator rate to verify.
catches: Upfluence sells software to brands; it is not an open creator marketplace with a published creator pay schedule.

Official creator-application and campaign pages describe flexible commissions and payments, but amounts are filled in per brand — the template leaves dollar amount, percentage, and payment days blank.
No concrete creator pay figure or platform-set commission mechanic exists in official public terms.
Rejected on the same bar as Insense, Trend, AspireIQ, Creator.co, and Tribe: no concrete official creator rate.

c1.evidence: Upfluence is a real influencer-marketing software company on the official upfluence.com domain.

c2.evidence: No concrete creator pay figure or commission mechanic in official public terms — payment terms are per-brand with blank amounts.

c3.evidence: No participation fee established from official public pages.

c4.evidence: No official payout quote exists — nothing concrete to quote.

eligibility: Creators apply to brand campaigns run by Upfluence's brand customers; pay terms are set per brand.
notes: Reviewed 2026-09-22: Upfluence's official pages cover creator applications and brand campaign payments, but every concrete number is a per-brand template field (blank by default). Under the user's bar, brand-set pricing alone is not a guarantee and must be disclosed — and here it cannot even be pinned down, so the route is rejected.
